authorization.request: 插件商城没有兼容 这个桌面端，所以不显示里面的列表，这个要做兼容。要显示列表可以直接安装等等，安装方式也要兼容DSH的桌面端。

objective: 修复官方 DSH Desktop 设置中的 DSH-Store 空商城；当前 0.9.14 的模块未声明 remote.pluginManager，正式桌面加载器未向其注入官方插件管理器服务。

change.behavior: 声明 slots、remote、remote.pluginManager 三项静态 Client 模块依赖；保持现有有界 Catalog 校验、Desktop 兼容门控及官方 inspect/installBundle 安装路径。
prohibited: 不得修改 DSH 核心或 @deepseek-ai 包
不得修改真实 Desktop Profile 或重启 DSH
不得修改 Catalog、作者联系账本或生产商城
不得点按安装器重试或再次安装同一 Git 仓库

gates: Client module statically declares slots, remote, and remote.pluginManager so the official Desktop loader provides its manager service.
Keep DSH-Store as a separate Settings section labelled DSH-Store.
Keep Catalog reads bounded and fail-closed; keep installation gated by Desktop profile support and exact DSH compatibility.
Keep typed confirmation with package name and the complete 40-character Commit, then call official inspect/installBundle only.
Do not enable DSH-Store self-installation, Profile mutation, enable/disable, uninstall, Guardian, or restart through Desktop mode.
Run desktop compatibility tests, npm run check, npm pack --dry-run, the fresh plan verifier, and exact-head CI before merge.
Treat the live post-fix Desktop UI, Catalog publication, and storefront readbacks as separate acceptance gates.
healthCheck: Disposable Desktop client harness must provide remote.pluginManager only when declared in the module dependency list; the DSH-Store view then loads the current Catalog, displays installed state, gates compatibility, and uses the official manager only after full-Commit confirmation. npm run check and exact-head CI must pass.
rollback: Revert only this exact source PR through a CI-checked PR. No real Desktop Profile mutation is in scope; existing Git history is the source rollback.
boundaries: Do not modify DSH source or any @deepseek-ai package.
Do not disable or shadow the official plugin inventory.
Do not call Loader/Fiber mutation APIs.
Do not mutate or restart the real Desktop Profile in this source PR.
Do not change Catalog records or production storefronts in this source PR.
Do not contact plugin authors or change the central contact ledger.

verification.liveDesktopBeforeFix: confirmed: DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5, dsh-safe-plugin-manager 0.9.14 running, DSH-Store is a separate Settings entry, and its panel reports DESKTOP_PLUGIN_MANAGER_UNAVAILABLE.
verification.officialDesktopApi: confirmed in the installed official Desktop runtime: ui-plugin-manager declares remote and remote.pluginManager as Client module dependencies and calls listBundles, inspect, installBundle, and waitForInstall.
verification.desktopClientTests: passed: 8/8 cases after strict static-dependency injection modeling.
verification.realDesktopAfterFix: pending: installed Profile remains 0.9.14; update/restart is a separately planned and explicitly confirmed mutation.
verification.catalogAndProductionSurfaces: unchanged by this source PR; require a separate fresh Catalog policy run and independent GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn readback.
